FN-5IGZM36-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 47
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Phillip Ensler
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/23/2024
House Bill 47 as introduced would exempt the Alabama State Missionary Baptist Convention
and its members that are in good standing from all state, county, and municipal sales and use
taxes which would decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund, county, and municipal funds
by an undetermined amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, dependent upon the amount of
taxes that would otherwise be collected.
In addition, this bill requires the Convention to provide an annual report of its members in good
standing to the Department of Revenue.
Page 1

FN-5IGZM36-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 47
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Phillip Ensler
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/28/2024
House Bill 47 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would decrease
sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount annually,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, dependent upon the purchases made by the Alabama State
Missionary Baptist Convention, Inc. and its members that are in good standing, which would be
exempt from state sales and use tax pursuant to this bill.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to local governments by an undetermined
amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, dependent upon the same purchases made by the
Convention or its members, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local
sales and use tax, pursuant to this bill:
In addition, this bill requires the Convention to provide an annual report of its members in good
standing to the Department of Revenue.
